sentences.text: TuniSea is a cohort company whose country is recorded as NO, and the record gives no founding date or industry code.
The dated events are a product launch on 2025-12-08, a first-hire record on 2026-07-10 at low confidence, and a programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site dated 2026-02-09.
No funding, patent or contract record exists in the sources we read, so every readiness level is unknown.
For the fund the company stays on the watchlist until a first public record shows traction.
